# Vimeo

> > Vimeo is an all-in-one video platform offering hosting, live streaming, video creation tools, and enterprise collaboration features with HTML5 player technology.

Vimeo serves creators, marketers, and enterprises with video hosting, Livestream Studio for live events, and integrated tools like screen recorders and video editors. The platform includes Vimeo Enterprise for business customers, HubSpot and Acquia integrations, and SSO capabilities for secure collaboration.

## Key Topics

- Vimeo Enterprise
- Livestream Studio
- HTML5 player
- Video hosting
- Live streaming
- Video collaboration
- Screen recorder
- Video tutorials
- Player error troubleshooting
- Privacy settings
- SSO (Single Sign-On)
- HubSpot integration
- iframe embedding
- macOS and Windows support
- Free plan features

## Platform Overview

- [Vimeo - All-in-One Video Platform](https://vimeo.com): Homepage for Vimeo's all-in-one video hosting, creation & collaboration platform
- [Video Platform Features](https://vimeo.com/features): Overview of Vimeo features: hosting, HTML5 player, screen recorder & more
- [Vimeo Watch](https://vimeo.com/watch): Video discovery page for streaming HD films, shorts, documentaries & more
- [Categories on Vimeo](https://vimeo.com/categories): Browse curated video collections by category: ads, animation, narrative & more
- [Vimeo Events, Live and On-Demand](https://vimeo.com/events): Live events, webinars & conferences for marketers and enterprise customers

## Getting Started & Support

- [About the Vimeo Free plan](https://help.vimeo.com/hc/en-us/articles/12425432518801-About-the-Vimeo-Free-plan): Details on Vimeo Free plan features, storage limits & upload capabilities
- [Troubleshoot player error messages](https://help.vimeo.com/hc/en-us/articles/12425812280081-Troubleshoot-player-error-messages): Guide to common Vimeo player errors including privacy, streaming & embed issues
- [Vimeo Academy - Free Video Tutorials & Resources](https://vimeo.com/vimeo-academy): Free courses & tutorials for mastering Vimeo platform features
- [How to make a Vimeo video](https://vimeo.com/blog/post/how-to-make-a-vimeo-create-video): Tutorial on using Vimeo Record & Video Creator for marketing videos

## Livestream Studio Documentation

- [How to install Livestream Studio](https://help.vimeo.com/hc/en-us/articles/31110636079633-How-to-install-Livestream-Studio): Installation guide for Livestream Studio on Windows and macOS systems
